descricion: The game randomly selects several images depending on the number of dice you choose.
The participant must tell a story to the other person by connecting all the images that appeared.
dados-historiosos.resumo: Tell a story by connecting the random images rolled on the dice.

descricion: The monitor reads a word and the teams must answer it.
If correct, they move to the next word; if they don't know it, they can say 'Pass the Word' to pass their turn.
It features three levels: Twelve words with ascending random letters, and in the hard level, all letters of the alphabet are included.
pasa-palabra.resumo: Answer in alphabetical order or say 'Pass the Word' to skip your turn.

descricion: Starting from an initial letter displayed on the screen, each player must say a word starting with the letter the previous word ended with.
In advanced levels, players are required to repeat previous words or avoid repeating words across sessions, under a strict time limit.
palabras-encadeadas.resumo: Chain words based on the last letter of the previous word within the time limit.

descricion: The app gives commands and actions based on body movements, gestures, or short movements that participants must execute within a tight time limit.
Commands range from simple individual actions to chained sequences of two movements.
simon-di.resumo: Perform body movements and actions guided by the app before time runs out.

descricion: The app introduces a topic from the past (such as old toys, school back then, or traditional crafts).
Seniors share experiences, memories, or how life was in their time, while youth listen, ask questions, and compare with the present to create an intergenerational dialogue.
baul-recordos.resumo: Share memories from the past and engage in intergenerational dialogue on various topics.
